name: Bibliotheca Aurea
_about: BIBLIOTHECA AUREA, the library and observatory of a learned academy (an original neoclassical design): on a terraced hill over a water parterre and a cascade stair, the Court of the Muses between Ionic colonnades, the core -- a cube of honey stone with a giant Corinthian order and a hexastyle portico -- round the domed ROTUNDA reading room (27 m across, three storeys of stacks behind sixteen giant columns, two galleries, a coffered inner dome open at its eye to a painted sky), the copper dome on its peristyled drum with the gilt globe 62 m up; the two long barrel-vaulted library galleries east and west with their galleries and spiral stairs, the Cabinet of Globes and the Observatory in the end pavilions under small domes; the upper garden with its basin and exedra. Built by tools/archgen/aurea.py (its docstring is the design document).
